# Local checkout browser fixture

Run `python3 packages/tests/fixtures/billing-checkout-browser/run.py` from a clean committed checkout. It archives that commit under a new `/tmp/disposabl-checkout-browser-*` directory, activates payments only in that archive, and patches only the archive's billing provider configuration and transport. The transport returns a synthetic customer balance and allows only the expected customer lookup and checkout attachment; it records attachment arguments in a fixture-only table and fails on other operations. The real pricing UI, auth, checkout action, and begin/finish mutations run unchanged. The valid synthetic HTTPS result is translated to a loopback HTTP destination labeled local test checkout; no transaction is fulfilled.

The launcher checks ports 3540, 3541 and 3549, runs its backend and browser under a loopback-only macOS sandbox, verifies the outbound deny, disables beacon and telemetry before sync, and uses empty Boat and no other provider configuration. It checks the local auth .8 version. Evidence and logs remain in the fresh temporary directory. The launcher stops only its own processes. This cannot prove provider behavior, a purchase, fulfillment, production configuration, or native payments.
